guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Break up heavy synchronous work; yield so interactions stay responsive (scheduler.yield with setTimeout fallback).

openQuestions: The detector is GPT-2-era by design and the pages say so loudly — is the "triage signal, never a verdict" framing strong enough that nobody screenshots a "reads machine-written" verdict as an accusation? The wild page's live failures (splice → 0%, modern-LLM-style → 0%, short aside → 53%) are the main guardrail.

Greedy vs sampled duel: on this small GPT-2 (124M) both arms scored 98–100% machine; the paper's nucleus-sampling effect may show more at temperature 1.2 with longer generations — worth a follow-up probe rung?

Obfuscated GPT-2 text still scored 89% machine (spacing words out didn't evade) — a stronger paraphrase arm (round-trip through m2m100 translation, already built) would make the evasion lesson land harder as a NEW wild page.
